response.sql:
WITH trans_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM trans_avgs
),
kept_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.transref,
    t.trans_avg
  FROM trans_avgs t
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val o
  WHERE t.trans_avg > o.overall_avg
),
kept_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_trans
)
SELECT 
  k.transref,
  k.trans_avg,
  k.trans_avg - o.overall_avg as above_overall,
  k.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg as above_kept
FROM kept_trans k
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val o
CROSS JOIN kept_avg_val ka
ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction is uniquely identified by transref. The sentimentandfundamentals table may contain multiple rows per transref (recording anlycount at different points in time or for different metrics), and we aggregate across all such rows.
